settings.subtitle: Our staff team is small and our volunteers are busy gardening, but every message gets a reply within two working days.

items.text: Joining, renewals, tiers, the low-income rate and group insurance.

items.title: Chapters
items.text: Finding your chapter, starting a new one, or getting in touch with a chapter lead.

items.title: Press and policy
items.text: Interviews, land-use questions and help when a garden is under threat.

items.q: I joined but cannot sign in yet.
items.a: Member logins are created within one business day of joining. If it has been longer, write to the membership team.
We share a small office at 1820 Fairmount Avenue in Philadelphia. Please email first so someone is there.

items.q: Do you give grants to gardens?
items.a: Yes, through the new gardens fund. Applications open each January for groups in neighbourhoods without fresh food.
